title: Machines that care
instructionsHu: Nézd meg a két kép leírását. Írd le és hasonlítsd össze a képeket, fejtsd ki a véleményedet a megadott szempontok alapján, majd beszélgess a vizsgáztatóval a robotok és a mesterséges intelligencia szerepéről az ápolásban és a gyógyításban.

scenes.description: In a care home, an elderly woman in a wheelchair is talking to a small white robot with a screen for a face. The robot is showing her photos of her grandchildren and reminding her to take her medicine. In the background, a nurse is hurrying past with a tray, clearly very busy. The woman is smiling at the robot as if it were an old friend.

In a hospital operating theatre, a surgeon is sitting at a control console, guiding the arms of a surgical robot that is operating on a patient. Two other doctors and a nurse are watching the screens closely. Everything is bright, clean and quiet, and the atmosphere is extremely focused.

prompts: Compare the roles that robots play in the two pictures.
In which areas of life can robots and AI be most helpful?
What are the risks of relying too much on machines, especially when caring for people?
followUpQuestions: Would you trust a robot to look after your grandparents? Why or why not?
Which jobs should always be done by humans?
Who should be responsible if a robot or an AI system makes a mistake?
How might artificial intelligence change medicine in the next twenty years?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text:
Both pictures show robots helping people, but their roles are quite different. In the first one, an elderly woman in a wheelchair is talking to a small white robot in a care home. The robot is showing her photos of her grandchildren and reminding her to take her medicine, and she's smiling at it as if it were an old friend. Meanwhile, a nurse is hurrying past, obviously very busy. In the second picture, a surgeon is sitting at a control console, guiding a surgical robot that is operating on a patient, while other doctors are watching the screens closely.
So in the operating theatre the robot is a precise tool controlled by a human, while in the care home it's almost replacing human company. In my opinion, robots and AI can be most helpful in medicine and in dangerous jobs, where precision matters. The risk is that we start relying on machines for things that need real human contact. It's a bit sad that the woman's best friend seems to be a robot – I think it shows that care homes don't have enough staff.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Would you trust a robot to look after your grandparents? Why or why not?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Only partly. A robot could remind my grandfather to take his pills, which he often forgets. But I wouldn't want it to replace visits from the family, because loneliness is a bigger problem for old people than forgetting their medicine.

notes: Összefüggő témakifejtés: a vizsgázó mindkét képet leírja, világosan összeveti a robot két szerepét (precíz eszköz kontra az emberi társaság pótléka), megnevezi, hol a leghasznosabb a technológia és mi a kockázata, a visszakérdezésre pedig személyes, a nagyapjához kötött példával felel.
Szókincs: pontos, témához illő szavak (care home, control console, precision, human contact, staff) és jó kötőszavak (Meanwhile, So, In my opinion).

Nyelvhelyesség: változatos B2-es szerkezetek hibátlanul – kötőmód az 'as if it were an old friend' szerkezetben, Present Continuous a leírásban, szenvedő igenév (a precise tool controlled by a human), 'start relying on' és összehasonlítás (a bigger problem … than).
Érdemes megtanulni: „as if it were an old friend”, „almost replacing human company”, „relying on machines”, „Only partly”.
